title: Coins keep their kind when money arrives
summary: Receiving money no longer changes a character's platinum and electrum into gold, silver and copper, and offline campaigns now follow the same coin rules as shared rooms.
items: Transfers, shop sales and approved loans add the new coins on top of the coins already in the purse, as DM payments already did. The total value is unchanged; only the coin mix is kept.

On a device campaign, approving a loan records the same coins and Activity line as a shared room ("Finance: Loan approved"), still leaves the approval note in messages, and is refused past the maximum coin balance.
On a device campaign, a DM payment is held to the same limits as a shared room: a note of at most 500 characters, and no purse above the maximum coin balance.
On a device campaign, editing a purse's coins is refused if they changed after you opened the edit, so an older edit cannot overwrite a newer one.
Giving part of a stack of items with charges gives full items and keeps the partly used one with the giver, the same as a shared-room transfer.
